messages:
sam: Heads-up — hitting a weird auth<>stream combo in the Next notebook starter (LangChain wiring). Notebook demo stalls on first streaming token then retries endlessly. Anyone seen this?
nisha: repro steps?
sam: steps: clone the starter, pip install -r requirements.txt, set REDWOOD_API_KEY env to an ephemeral key from the console, run the notebook cell that calls chain.run. Sometimes the cell starts streaming then dies. Browser console shows a 401 after a few tokens, then the client retries and we see 429s and backoff.
ben: which SDK are you using, Py or JS?
sam: Python (redwood==0.8.1) + langchain 0.0.200. Repro on macOS + colab.
alina: Can you paste the minimal snippet + the raw request/response logs? Also whether this is a server-side (notebook kernel) or client/browser stream.
sam: snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"])
chain = some_langchain_wrapper(client)
chain.run("summarize ... long doc")
```
logs (sanitized):
```
[2025-03-14T15:12:03Z] POST /v1/generate 200 stream-start
[2025-03-14T15:12:45Z] STREAM ERROR: 401 Unauthorized (auth expired)
[2025-03-14T15:12:45Z] SDK RETRY attempt=1 after 401
[2025-03-14T15:12:46Z] POST /v1/generate 429 Too Many Requests
[2025-03-14T15:12:47Z] SDK BACKOFF 10s
```
Error seen in notebook: "Stream connection closed unexpectedly" then kernel keeps retrying and UI never recovers.
nisha: sounds like ephemeral key TTL mismatch — if the token expires mid-stream the SDK should not blindly retry a streaming request. JS had a fix for this recently to surface auth failures instead of retrying.
ben: yup — SDK parity note: JS SDK (v0.7.5+) added a guard to stop retries on 401 during an active stream. Python still retries by default. Could be the loop here (401 -> retry -> 429 -> backoff -> repeat). I opened an issue internally.
sam: I can reproduce reliably after 3-5 runs if the stream lasts >60s. Our onboarding doc uses ephemeral demo keys (TTL=60s) to avoid long-lived tokens in examples. That safety is causing UX pain for notebooks.
alina: quick mitigation: update the starter to recommend a longer-lived demo token for local runs and add a big callout in the notebook cells. Long-term we should update the Python SDK to treat 401 as fatal for active streams.
nisha: agree. I can add an eval harness test that simulates a stream lasting 90s and assert we fail-fast on 401 instead of retrying. That'll prevent regressions.
ben: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-starters/pull/123 — adds NOTE in README, env var REDWOOD_DEMO_TOKEN and bumps the starter's pinned SDK to 0.8.2-rc which contains a 401-stream guard. Also added a tiny notebook cell that checks token TTL before calling the long stream.
sam: pulled the PR and verified — my repro no longer loops, notebook shows a clear "auth expired" error and suggests re-auth. Thanks!
deploy-bot: deploy preview for pr-123 is ready: https://deploy.preview/redwood/devex-starters/pr-123 :rocket:
alina: Nice. Next steps: SDK team — can you backport the 401-stream guard to the main Py SDK (non-rc) and cut a patch? Also update the onboarding quickstart to call out recommended token types for notebooks vs CI.
ben: noted. I'll follow up on the SDK issue and add the eval harness test once the PR merges.
sam: thanks all — pushing a small comment in the notebook to help new users avoid this trap.
